items.title: Robb Discusses Winter Reliability Outlook and Preparedness
items.summary: As winter approaches, extreme cold weather and increased electricity demand can pose significant challenges to the reliability of the bulk power system. In a new video message, NERC President and CEO Jim Robb discusses the outlook for winter 2026–2027.

items.title: EIA raises November natural gas storage forecast after warm start to month
items.summary: The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) expects almost 70 billion cubic feet more natural gas to be in U.S. storage at the end of November than it forecast in October. A warm start to the month is easing pressure on natural gas prices.

items.title: US issues landmark construction permit for Texas SMR plant
items.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has issued a construction permit for the proposed plant featuring four Xe-100 small modular reactor units at Dow's Seadrift site - the first construction permit for a high-temperature gas-cooled reactor issued in the USA in nearly 60 years.

items.summary: French small modular reactor developer Calogena has been awarded EUR40 million (USD44.6 million) through the European Commission's Innovation Fund to support the potential construction of its first commercial nuclear reactor in Pierrelatte, in southern France.
